mistake_reason: At step 4, the orchestrator explicitly reasoned that the team must avoid third-party summaries and confirm directly on the official Merriam-Webster page. However, it then instructed WebSurfer to open a third-party digest and extract the writer from there “to get a quick sense,” contradicting its own stated plan. This reasoning-action mismatch (FM-2.6) led the team to adopt the incorrect attribution (Annie Lowrey) instead of verifying the correct writer on the official page (Annie Levin). Subsequent steps compounded this by deferring and ultimately skipping the verification, resulting in the wrong final answer.
